objective: Implement the canonical semantic header parser. Every source file walked produces a HeaderFact and a headerStatus. @layer validates against STANDARDS/layers.json at runtime. @exports cross-checks against AST exports. Files transition out of headerStatus='missing'.

in: Implement a header parser in src/pipeline/ that consumes the BNF defined in analyze-coderef-semantics/SKILL.md.
Emit raw header facts (new HeaderFact structure) alongside raw import/call/export facts.
Cross-check @exports against the AST's actual exports; set headerStatus = 'stale' for mismatches.
Set headerStatus = 'missing' for files with no header.
Set headerStatus = 'partial' for files with malformed headers and attach a structured parse-error record.
Validate @layer against STANDARDS/layers.json enum at runtime using src/pipeline/element-taxonomy.ts.
Replace RawHeaderImportFact placeholders with structured HeaderImportFact records (each <module>:<symbol> becomes parsed fields).
out: Hardcoding @layer enum in TypeScript (STANDARDS/layers.json is canonical and loaded at runtime)

hard_constraints: Read-only agent, no source code edits, no staging, no commits.
Produce context.json and analysis.json in the current directory.
Adhere to the canonical BNF grammar for semantic headers.
Validate @layer against STANDARDS/layers.json at runtime using src/pipeline/element-taxonomy.ts.
Do not resolve @imports; that is Phase 3's responsibility.
Do not implement --strict-headers validation; that is Phase 6's responsibility.
